thought.text: The runner likely needs the DB password (the server was started with PGPASSWORD=root). Retrying with that:

reasoning_content: Error in rails runner — probably a DB connection issue (no PGPASSWORD for the root user). The running server was started with PGPASSWORD=root. Let me check the actual error at the top of the output and retry with PGPASSWORD=root.

action.command:
cd /workspace && export PATH=/usr/local/ruby/bin:/opt/node/bin:$PATH PGPASSWORD=root && timeout 400 bin/rails runner '
u = User.find_for_database_authentication(login: "admin@consul.dev")
puts "found: #{!u.nil?} id=#{u&.id}"
puts "valid_password: #{u && u.valid_password?("Aa12345678")}"
puts "active_for_auth: #{u && u.active_for_authentication?}"
res = User.authenticate(login: "admin@consul.dev", password: "Aa12345678")
puts "authenticate result: #{res ? "SUCCESS id=#{res.id}" : "FAIL"}"
' 2>&1 | tail -8
